title: Missing and dead scientists: Loureiro, Gilmore, McCasland

tellings.quote: cases people are talking about Nuno Lorero who basically ran MIT's plasma fusion lab.

plain: A handful of scientists and officials tied to advanced research are said to have gone missing or died. Among them are a man named Nuno Loureiro, who in Michels's words "basically ran MIT's plasma fusion lab" (MIT is a leading American university, and plasma fusion is research into power from superheated gas), a man named Carl Gilmore linked to Caltech, another top American university, and a man named Neil McCasland linked to Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, a US Air Force base. Michels raises these as "cases people are talking about" while speaking with the researcher Jeffrey Mishlove, without naming a source or saying more about what happened to each, and the point of raising them is that such losses might be connected rather than chance.
